answer_body: It is recommendable to consult with an elder law attorney to determine the best approach under Florida law. Typically, these cases are seen in guardianship context, if the elderly individual is presumed to lack some capacity, although lack of capacity is not required for exploitation cases. A guardianship litigation attorney is best suited to evaluate each case and provide a recommendation.
